caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher with a rounded body and a narrow neck. The top portion, including the neck, spout, and handle, is a dark brown color with a glossy finish, while the lower portion of the pitcher is an off-white, cream color with a matte appearance. The handle is attached to the upper section and curves out from the side of the neck. There is a clear separation between the brown and cream sections. The pitcher is centered on a plain, beige background. In the lower right corner of the image, the name "LUCILLE MONSON" is stamped or printed in uppercase letters. There are no other objects or decorations in the composition.
title: Crockery Pitcher
